title: JD.com Releases Super Brain Large Model 3.0, Speeding Up the Planning of 100 Million Packages to Seconds
excerpt: On August 26th, JD.com officially launched its "Super Brain" large model 3.0 at the 18th International Transportation Technology and Equipment Exhibition. Compa
content_html:
On August 26th, JD.com officially launched its "Super Brain" large model 3.0 at the 18th International Transportation Technology and Equipment Exhibition. Compared to version 2.0, the new model has been optimized in terms of operational efficiency, system resilience, and operational costs, further enhancing the intelligence level of the logistics supply chain.

According to the introduction, the "Super Brain" large model 3.0 has compressed the solving time for end-to-end optimal route planning of hundreds of millions of packages from minutes to seconds, achieving precise scheduling from warehousing to delivery, enabling packages to complete fulfillment more efficiently. The system covers the entire logistics process and coordinates and optimizes warehousing, transportation, and delivery through AI.

JD.com stated that the "Super Brain" large model 3.0 is the first industrial-level large model application integration in the logistics industry that is guided by AI throughout the entire process from warehousing to delivery, and it is also one of the largest applications of AI large models in the full supply chain scenario so far.

Currently, JD.com is accelerating the construction of the world's largest physical world operation center and continuously promoting the integration of AI technology with the real economy. As the logistics industry enters an intelligent upgrade phase, industrial-level AI large models are evolving from single-point applications to overall supply chain operations, becoming an important technical foundation for improving efficiency and reducing operational costs.
